findings.reviewedBy: core_intake_review (test author; root independent review required)
findings.reason: One pure host-lifetime suite (19 controls) using the real governed workflow, public synthetic receiving fixtures and real QueryClient. Shared setup owns only synthetic fetch/clock and deterministic cleanup. Three describe groups separate explicit connection, temporary availability/revocation and navigation journal scope. No production services or second authority implementation are introduced; retaining these related ownership controls together makes their shared lifecycle and regression evidence reviewable.

findings.reviewedBy: core_intake_review (test author; root independent review required)
findings.reason: One explicit connection-lifetime group: construction inactivity, captured hints, mismatched receipt refusal, late bootstrap disposal, StrictMode replay, idle expiry and validated access loss. Each case asserts observable dispatch/snapshot/signal effects; the group has no monolithic production control flow.
